title: Predicate family baseline
statement: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a finite nonempty family of sign predicates. Its baseline is the minimum, over predicates in $\mathcal{P}$, of the constant Fourier coefficient of the predicate's acceptance indicator on its input cube.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nonempty index type for the predicate family
A sign predicate assigned to each index
